status: isolated experiment; not activated; not integrated

dataset.note: Includes 'open', which the manifest marks as dynamic but the approved 27-name list omitted. Confirm before any headline result.
dataset.clip_assumption: each phrase folder is one assumed clip; frame rate unknown

windows.resampling: none (windows keep original frame indices; no playback speed change)

features.source: signbridge_training/features.py::features (imported read-only through backend loader load_feature_module)
features.missing_hand: zero blocks, as in the existing window builder
features.nonfinite_inputs: converted to absent hands and reported in the quality report

distance.normalisation: total cost / (T + S), i.e. 64 for two 32-frame windows

rejection.threshold_rule: 95th percentile of in-set nearest different-clip distance
rejection.validation: none possible with one recording per phrase

evaluation.reproducibility: distance matrix computed twice and compared exactly

neural_model.reason: 28 assumed clips; no GRU or TensorFlow or PyTorch installed; no independent evaluation possible
